terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of MarrowMail's business email hosting, mailboxes, and related tools. Please read them carefully.

sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By creating a MarrowMail account or using our services, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you don't agree, please don't use MarrowMail.

sections.heading: What MarrowMail Provides
sections.body: MarrowMail provides professional business email hosting on your own domain, including mailboxes, role-based addresses, storage, and optional AI-powered tools such as summarization, translation, and rewrite assistance.

sections.heading: Your Account
sections.body: You're responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account. You must provide accurate information when signing up and keep it up to date.

sections.heading: Billing & Payment
sections.body: Mailboxes are billed per seat, per month, in XAF. We accept Orange Money, MTN MoMo, and major cards. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled before the next billing date; fees already paid are non-refundable except where required by law.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use
sections.body: You agree not to use MarrowMail to send spam, malware, or unlawful content, or to impersonate others. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate this policy or put other customers' deliverability at risk.

sections.heading: AI Features
sections.body: Optional AI tools process your email content to generate summaries, translations, and suggested rewrites. We do not use the content of your emails to train AI models or for advertising.

sections.heading: Domains & DNS
sections.body: If you connect a domain you already own, you're responsible for maintaining accurate DNS records. MarrowMail is not responsible for delivery issues caused by DNS misconfiguration outside our control.

sections.heading: Service Availability
sections.body: We work to keep MarrowMail reliable, but we don't guarantee uninterrupted service. Planned maintenance and unplanned outages may occasionally affect availability.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.body: You may cancel your subscription at any time from your dashboard. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, with notice where practical.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: MarrowMail is provided "as is." To the extent permitted by law, we aren't liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. We'll post the updated version here with a new effective date; continued use after changes means you accept them.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms? Reach us at support@marrowmails.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information MarrowMail collects, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect account information (name, email, business domain), the content of emails you send and receive through MarrowMail, and basic usage data needed to operate the service.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use this information to provide and improve the email service, process payments, respond to support requests, and keep your account secure.

sections.heading: AI Processing
sections.body: When you use AI features like summarization or rewrite suggestions, your email content is processed to generate that specific result. We don't use your conversations to train AI models or for ad targeting.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: Payments are processed by our Mobile Money and card payment partners. MarrowMail does not store your full card number or Mobile Money PIN.

sections.heading: Data Storage & Security
sections.body: Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We apply industry-standard safeguards to protect your mailbox from unauthorized access.

sections.heading: Sharing of Information
sections.body: We don't sell your data. We only share information with service providers who help us run MarrowMail, such as payment processors and infrastructure providers, under confidentiality obligations.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your account and email data for as long as your account is active. If you close your account, we delete or anonymize your data within a reasonable period, except where we're required to keep it longer by law.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You can access, export, or request deletion of your data at any time by contacting support or using the tools in your dashboard.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your preferences, such as language and sidebar settings.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: MarrowMail is intended for business use and isn't directed at children under 16.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy periodically. We'll post changes here with a new effective date.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about your data? Reach us at privacy@marrowmails.com.
